name: Pemberton
description: Houses stand close together, a five-minute walk from the school and the shops. There is no church or parish hall within three blocks. The high street keeps a Somali grocery, a taqueria and a bakery, all opened this year. The streets climb a hill a mile inland, well above the water and the flood line.

name: Eastvale
description: There is no church or parish hall within three blocks. The high street has barely changed: the same shops run by the same families for decades. This neighbourhood sits on the flood plain, a few feet above the water at high tide. Houses sit far apart, a five-minute drive from the school and the shops.

name: Norwood
description: The high street keeps a diner and a hardware store in the same families for decades. A mile inland and uphill, these streets sit well above the water and the flood line. The school and shops sit a five-minute walk from these small, close-packed lots. No congregation holds services within three blocks of these houses.

name: Brackley
description: The streets climb a hill a mile inland, well above the water and the flood line. Lots are wide, and the school and shops are a five-minute drive away. Two churches and a parish hall sit three blocks away. A diner and a hardware store have been run by the same two families for decades.

name: Larkfield
description: Houses are tightly packed, a five-minute walk from the school and the shops. Two churches and a parish hall stand within three blocks. The high street has turned over: four shops opened this spring, each with a new sign. This neighbourhood sits on high ground, a mile from the water and above the flood plain.

name: Cawdor
description: Three congregations hold services within three blocks of these houses. The high street keeps a Somali grocery, a taqueria and a bakery, all opened this year. Tides have come over the seawall twice this decade, and the streets end at the water. The school and shops sit a five-minute drive from these wide, well-spaced lots.

name: Harrowgate
description: Almost every shopfront on the high street has changed hands at least once in three years. The flood maps leave this area clear, and the water is a mile downhill from here. Houses stand well apart, a five-minute drive from the school and the shops. No church or parish hall stands three blocks from here.

name: Invermay
description: The water is two streets away, and flood maps mark half this area as at risk. Houses stand close together, a five-minute walk from the school and the shops. A church and a parish hall stand three blocks away. Nearly every shop on the high street has passed from parent to child for three generations.
